notes: Classic form — first episode with a full Breakdown after two consecutive vignettes (M54, M56). Old regular's wordless 'என்ன இருக்கா?' is the vivid character ingredient; Host B accidentally mirrors the tic ('எதுவாவது சரிதான்') before Host A calls her out. Breakdown obsesses over ONE beat: question-as-want (இருக்கா? vs வேணும்) — Maya reads structure, Raj reads relationship. Tenderness register holds throughout: the old man is beloved, not mocked. Unfenced: கிழவரு (old man — visually obvious), ரோஜூம் (every day — context answers it), வருஷக்கணக்கா (for years — context answers it).
